title: rosa gallica var. cristata
intro: Rosa gallica var. cristata, commonly known as the Old Blush or French Rose, is a variety of the Rosa gallica species, a type of wild rose that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its health benefits such as soothing skin irritations and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica var. cristata include acting as a demulcent, astringent, and vulnerary, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
